notes: Fine-Tuning, LwF, and EWC use GradScaler but their registered train-log schema does not serialize skipped-update counters, so their values are unavailable rather than zero.
L3A guarded skips are confined to Task-0 gradient training before the analytic stages.
No training log contains a fatal CUDA OOM, traceback, or NaN marker.
All 36 jobs produced complete finite metrics and twelve canonical score shards.

interpretation_notes: MULTI-LANE ranks first in final and average mAP; Original-DDP-Tau2 ranks second and is the most seed-stable leading method.
PRS and DER++ differ by only 0.1362 final-mAP points, which is smaller than their seed variability.
CSC retains threshold-free mAP but has a persistent fixed-0.5 confidence-calibration failure.
AGCN has the lowest forgetting but also a low Task-0 and final mAP, so forgetting must not be interpreted alone.
Average mAP and forgetting are protocol-trajectory metrics and are not directly exchangeable across B4-C2, B5-C3, and B10-C4.
